{"metadata":{"description":"Codex App Server model provider for DeepSeek Harness using your local Codex login.","id":"gh:1334832975","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-codex","slug":"wss534857356/dsh-plugin-codex","topics":["codex","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Codex App Server model provider for DeepSeek Harness using your local Codex login."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-llm-codex-app-server"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-llm-codex-app-server` registers a DeepSeek Harness main-model provider backed by the locally au"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"thenticated Codex App Server. It is an out-of-tree Harness bundle, so installing it does not modify "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"the `deepseek-harness` repository."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This differs from Harness's built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`. The built-in package exposes"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" Codex as a delegated child Agent. This package registers on `ctx.llm`, so `codex-local` is a select"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"able provider for the Harness Agent loop."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Screenshot"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"CDP capture log and verification details"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"An ordinary Harness conversation session reuses one pinned `@openai/codex@0.154.0` App Server in a p"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"rivate empty directory and one ephemeral thread while its bounded cache lease remains valid. The pro"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"cess uses the native Codex account state under `CODEX_HOME`; the plugin never reads, copies, logs, o"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"r stores OAuth tokens or API keys. Requests without a session id and auxiliary requests remain one-s"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ores OAuth tokens or API keys. Requests without a session id and auxiliary requests remain one-shot."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The adapter supplies the Harness system text as App Server base instructions, reconstructs cold thre"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ads by injecting all logged Harness messages before an empty turn, declares Harness tools under the "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"`deepseek_harness` App Server namespace, and sends later ordinary user messages through native turn "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"input. When one DSH step appends several inbox messages, the first starts the turn and the rest ente"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"r that same turn through ordered `turn/steer` requests. The outer Harness `skill` tool is exposed th"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ere as `harness_skill`; its argument schema accepts only names from the current Harness session cata"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"log, while Codex-native skills stay on Codex's own loader. A warm thread is reused only when the com"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"plete request is an append-only continuation the adapter can reproduce; otherwise it is discarded an"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"d rebuilt. App Server still adds Codex-owned instructions and tools. This is deliberately a layered "},{"id":"p10s10","text":"provider, not a raw-model transport or a claim that Harness replaces the Codex prompt."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"This release targets DSH `>=0.1.5-rc.1 <0.2.0`. Its browser manifest declares the current `ui-chat` "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"slot owner and renderer in DSH's informational client graph; the removed `dsh-client-runtime` module"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" is not part of that roster."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Authenticate the native CLI once:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"After a release is available from npm, install the immutable published version:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"To build and pack this checkout instead, first check out `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` at `183f08e9"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"c6dde7e36cd2318eaee70b0da08fb35e` beside this repository as `../deepseek-harness`, then prepare its "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"aee70b0da08fb35e` beside this repository as `../deepseek-harness`, then prepare its linked packages:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Install the generated tarball into a Harness profile:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The bundle registers provider `codex-local` and every model shown by the pinned App Server's default"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" picker: `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `gpt-5.5`, and `gpt-5.3-code"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"x-spark`. Select one in the Models UI. Installation does not replace the profile's default model aut"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"omatically. App Server routes marked as hidden are not added to the selector."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Harness profiles set `autoInstallPeers: false`, so installation may report missing peer dependencies"},{"id":"p23s2","text":". At boot, the profile module fallback supplies those peers from the current Harness installation so"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" the plugin shares its Cordis and service instances."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"For source installation:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Append `#<commit>` to pin a revision. The package's `prepare` script builds TypeScript during a Git "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"install, so pnpm must allow that package build. A packed tarball or npm release is already built."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Remove the bundle from the profile with:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Compatibility and limitations"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- The protocol baseline is Codex CLI `0.154.0`; the dependency and runtime handshake are pinned beca"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"use the experimental App Server protocol is version-sensitive.
- App Server uses the default `~/.cod"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"ex` directory unless `CODEX_HOME` selects another directory. It starts with `--strict-config`; the s"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"elected home must contain keys accepted by Codex `0.154.0`. Remove an obsolete top-level `network_ac"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"cess = "enabled"` line before starting. `danger-full-access` already permits network access; `worksp"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"ace-write` supports the boolean `network_access` under `[sandbox_workspace_write]`.
- The static cat"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"alog retains the local Codex metadata context windows: `272000` for GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/L"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"una, and GPT-5.5; and `128000` for GPT-5.3 Codex Spark. Codex `0.154.0` `model/list` does not expose"},{"id":"p32s9","text":" a `contextWindow` field, so these values remain explicit deployment metadata and can be overridden."},{"id":"p32s10","text":" A provider-confirmed context overflow remains eligible for Harness compaction and retry.
- The defa"},{"id":"p32s11","text":"ult model catalog is a dated `model/list` snapshot observed on 2026-09-12 with App Server `0.154.0`:"},{"id":"p32s12","text":" GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, and GPT-5.5 declared text+image input; GPT-5.3 Codex Spark dec"},{"id":"p32s13","text":"lared text only. The server/account catalog may change independently of the package, so every Codex "},{"id":"p32s14","text":"upgrade must re-probe it. Custom entries without `inputModalities` and unlisted ids remain text-only"},{"id":"p32s15","text":".
- Codex co-owns the model-visible instructions and tool catalog. The keyless wire test records the"},{"id":"p32s16","text":" extra permission, primary-agent, collaboration, environment, interaction, and code-mode layers that"},{"id":"p32s17","text":" remain after supported thread overrides.
- Code Mode remains enabled because `gpt-5.6-sol` uses it "},{"id":"p32s18","text":"to dispatch App Server dynamic tools. Native image viewing stays enabled; image generation defaults "},{"id":"p32s19","text":"on for ordinary turns but can be disabled in the plugin settings card, and remains off for compactio"},{"id":"p32s20","text":"n and search processes. This image-generation switch is a capability flag of the pinned App Server `"},{"id":"p32s21","text":"0.154.0`, not a stable top-level Codex configuration key. Unrelated optional native integrations rem"},{"id":"p32s22","text":"ain disabled.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"See Build and release for the cross-platform CI matrix, npm package guard, first-publication bootstr"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ap, trusted-publisher setup, and version-tag procedure."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
